name: Bridgewater Deepwood Radio Access
source:
Hello out there to all our insomniacs, investigators, and alien eyeliner enthusiasts! You're listening to the Wyching Hours here on BDWA Radio, bringing you the strangest tales from the Bridgewater Triangle and surrounding regions each and every weekday from midnight to 4am. If you're already up, why not give us a call? There's got to be something strange in your life, right? Maybe it's just something you haven't noticed yet.


Bridgewater Deepwood Access Radio is a horror anthology VN centered around a late night paranormal call-in show, hosted by two lesbians who are definitely work enemies and definitely not secretly into each other. They're absolutely not keeping any sort of terrible secrets, either.

[From [url=https://runa-liore.itch.io/bdwa-radio]itch.io[/url]]
